title: Chronicles batch04 persons_2 independent current-byte source/profile review
reviewer: acts_people_three (independent reviewer; did not author persons_2 batch04)
methodJa: 現行60草稿・証拠ファイルを全件SHA固定。固定WEB引用を原文座標/文字列へ照合し、knownBy時点のsubtitle/summary/identity note/role/Wikipedia noteと後続factを見直した。英語Wikipedia記事・共有一覧の該当本文も現行ページで実読した。作者のbody-readログ/HTTP・構造監査だけでは独立意味passとしない。null候補は検索実読により存在が確認できた候補を列記し、未検索/未実読をno-fit扱いしない。

findings.reasonJa: The article’s Iram entry is for Genesis 36:43, not a 1CH-specific independent identification. It explicitly discusses an Edomite chief and possible clan interpretation (A–K lines 3397–3401); related-section and uncertainty note are apt. The 1CH 1:54 WEB is also an Edomite chief list, but it does not prove same person across books.

wiki.storedLocator: A–K list, “Iram”, lines 3397–3401; identifies Iram as an Edomite tribal leader in Genesis 36:43 and notes a possible clan reading.

findings.reasonJa: WEB 4:17 calls Ishbah a “father of Eshtemoa”; live List of minor biblical tribes article lines 333–337 interprets the name as a clan and notes textual alternatives. Draft accurately preserves this tension rather than asserting a clan as primary identity. It is an appropriate related-only use, not direct identity proof.

wiki.storedLocator: “Ishbah” section, lines 333–337; says the name is a clan in 1 Chronicles 4:17 and explains the genealogical personification / MT–LXX difference.
A–K list, “Ishi”, lines 3441–3450; second item identifies the Judah chief and father of Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
Jesiah article lines 102–104 and reference 3 at line 113; identifies the Isshiah/Ishiah variant in 1 Chronicles 7:1–3.

findings.reasonJa: Known-by 12:4の常時Wikipedia noteがゼブルン指導者の同名者（27:19）と比較し、後の人物を先取りする。Gibeonite warriorと1CH12:4だけの説明に限定するかリンク/注記を非表示gateへ。

Known-by 2:1で常時 identityNote が「後の箇所」の部族・領域用例を予告している。本文上の祖先用法と集団/地理用法を分ける方針は妥当だが、この情報は初出欄から除き、対応節のfactまたは非表示レビュー根拠へ。Wikipedia nullもfalse negative: 実読したIssachar記事本文183–184行はヤコブの子・部族創始者を同定し、184行はeponymous interpretationを留保する。英語記事を候補として追加し、族祖/集団解釈の留保を保つ。
Known-by 1:41のidentityNoteは「同じ書のアシェル系譜にも同名者」と明示し、7:37の将来用例を先取りする。初出欄はディションの子という当該節情報に限定し、別系譜との区別は後続節のfact/gated noteへ。現在のWikipedia注記も二人を比較するので表示gateを後ろへずらすか初出時は注記を出さない。

Assignment candidate is 1CH4:24, but fixed WEB 4:24 is Simeon’s sons and does not name Jachin. Current draft’s 9:10/24:17 priestly-division figure is a different name-bearing use (1CH9:10 says Jachin in priest list; 24:17 associates division 21). Do not import the Simeon son in 4:24 or treat that candidate occurrence as support. Current book-local priest profile may remain if sourced only by 9:10/24:17; evidence must explicitly reject 4:24. Wikipedia Jachin page/1CH24 context may be reviewed as candidate, but the dedicated A–K Jachin section lines 3670–74 is Simeon son only.

overallLimitationsJa: This review records identified concrete defects and independently read candidates, not approval by hashing or parsing. All no-link profiles still require candidate-specific article review where noted; 20+ active nulls were not conclusively searched to a no-fit result and remain open. Two null profiles remain held. Existing Article read evidence for other active links is bound to current URLs/locators; sections in the shared A–K page were checked live. Citation excerpt checks and all current hashes are in rows.
